workspace_projections.template:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Config
preferences: {}
clusters:
  - name: brokered-cluster
    cluster:
      server: https://kubernetes-api.example.com:443
      certificate-authority-data: REPLACE_WITH_BASE64_PEM_CA_DATA
users:
  - name: brokered-user
    user:
      token: "${HANDLE}"
contexts:
  - name: brokered-context
    context:
      cluster: brokered-cluster
      user: brokered-user
current-context: brokered-context
